scope: All locally available native sweeps; no latitude, EBV ceiling, or common-depth admission; display independent of scientific stream recovery

gr.transmission: finite positive catalog MW_TRANSMISSION, 2D full column

old_domain.comparison: same new display entrance within old geographic/dust/depth domain; legacy stricter source entrance counted separately

rgb.zero_rule: covered pixels with zero raw channel counts remain zero; only geometric missingness is masked
rgb.coverage: independent random gr geometry; observed-source geometric evidence retains rare random-empty edge pixels with smoothed-area support

ridge.parent: frozen target/member, exclude direct fit/calibration, low crowding; all finite native grz and PSF; do not require QRF/theory support; primary unmasked and masked supplement
ridge.model_version: MIST1.2, DECam AB, vvcrit0.4, alpha0; original MIST1.0 FOS separately retained
ridge.alpha: MIST1.2 fixed alpha0; no MIST2.5 switch or alpha fit
ridge.ridge: median colors in Mg_ref bins; two iterations fixed +/-0.10mag both-color core; require core>=60% and N>=8; full scatter and rejected modes retained
ridge.extinction_sensitivity: common catalog-column correction scale0.75/1/1.25, plus +/-0.01 E(B-V) clipped to E>=0; no dust fit
ridge.model_projection: original evolutionary segments; horizontal fixed-Mg color intersections and fixed-color vertical intersections; nearest observed complementary color/reference luminosity only for diagnostic branch identification
ridge.correction: No new distance correction fitted in this round. Diagnose gray versus shape and v5 scale/width on same members before choosing a future calibration. Keep original FOS zero point and draws unchanged.

annotations.band_diagnostic: raw PSF/valid-gr/CMD versus area/dust/depth and fixed latitude/Sgr strips; one no-extinction CMD overview on exactly the same admitted sources, preserving observed-input selection
